record.title: Prepare one conventional Linux ADB stock-state observation
record.intent: Replace the stopped Mac transport while retaining the accepted specimen and RF invariants.
requirements: Pin the accepted Linux link/lease/capture review and original stock-readiness inventory. Prepare a fresh output and ordinary foreground Linux ADB server with explicitly owned PID/birth/listen address inside the isolated namespace. Use the already evidenced specimen ADB endpoint, not discovery or scans. Disable avoidable automatic discovery through verified supported settings and record actual tool hashes/version and runtime argv.

Prepare one bounded connect, UID-first read-only observation, boot/process and exact APK/native mapping/hash comparison, protected-content hash comparison and one current UI screenshot. Bind expected files and byte identities from preserved corpus evidence; do not treat the SCPI software prefix as firmware equality. No root restart, reboot, remount, daemon property or native/entitlement/calibration change is included. An insufficient UID is a concrete stop.

Bind the existing fixed stock bandwidth observer only if its identity and current mappings are verified; no new helper is staged before these checks. Preserve its established bounded read budget and 17/17 interpretation. One read-only observation supplies current readiness evidence, not RF samples or a new warm-up claim.

Review source, failure branches and actual resource lifetime independently before execution. Fresh full capture and exact namespace/carrier/no-forward/default checks are required. Retained lease validity must be evaluated in its explicit clock domain; do not start duplicate DHCP or infer a new lease. Gracefully retire the owned ADB/capture and retain actual drop statistics. Keep Mac controllers and old automation stopped.
acceptance: One concrete bounded standard ADB observation is ready or a specific preparation limitation is preserved without physical execution.
